recipes.title: Breakfast Quesadilla

ingredients.name: cooked breakfast sausage or breakfast meat, crumbled
hash brown patty, cooked and crumbled

steps: In a small bowl, whisk the egg, milk, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder until well blended.
Heat cooking oil or butter in a small nonstick skillet over medium-low heat.
Add the diced red onion and diced tomato, sautéing for 1 minute until softened.
Pour in the whisked egg mixture, gently scramble until softly set, then remove from heat.
Lay the flour tortilla flat on a clean skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Scatter half of the shredded cheddar cheese over one half of the tortilla.
Layer on the scrambled eggs, crumbled breakfast sausage, and crumbled cooked hash brown.
Top with remaining cheddar cheese and fold the empty half of the tortilla over the filling to create a half-moon.
Cook for 2 to 3 minutes per side, pressing gently with a spatula, until the tortilla is golden-brown and crisp and the cheese is thoroughly melted.
Cut into wedges and serve warm with optional salsa.
recipes.swaps: Can substitute bacon or turkey sausage for pork sausage; pepper jack cheese can replace cheddar.
recipes.notes: Equipment: Small nonstick skillet, spatula. Portable, satisfying egg-based meal.
